title: Minimum Element After Replacement With Digit Sum
summary: Given an integer array, replace each element with the sum of its digits, then return the smallest element in the modified array.
statement: Given an integer array, replace each element with the sum of its digits, then return the smallest element in the modified array.
constraints: Replace every number conceptually by the sum of its decimal digits.
Return the smallest resulting digit sum.
All input values are positive integers.
reference_solution:
def minimum_digit_sum_element(nums):
    return min(sum(int(char) for char in str(value)) for value in nums)
hints: Compute each number’s decimal digit sum independently.
String conversion offers a direct way to enumerate decimal digits.
Every conceptual replacement is inspected, so the maintained minimum is the requested answer.
